Why play? Well, play is at the heart of everything we do. It\u2019s the blocky backbone of our games, the core of our development philosophy, and even the origin of our name. From the relentless experimentation of our endlessly inspiring community to the classrooms where Minecraft has become an essential teaching tool, play is the bedrock of our existence.\u00a0 \u00a0 

We enable millions to create and play together, connect people across the globe, and foster a community that is among the most active and passionate in the world. Our community is global and incredibly diverse. When we are developing anything within our franchise, we keep this in mind. We want everyone to not only feel included in Minecraft, but also to see themselves in what we make. Our goal is for the Mojang Studios team to be as diverse as our community.\u00a0 \u00a0 

As a Senior Software Engineer in Minecraft Realms, you will have the unique challenge of working with the developers in the\u00a0world\u2019s best-selling game! The work you will be doing revolves around systems that support the player\u2019s journey to find the fun playing together in online experiences.\u00a0 \u00a0 

You'll join a cross-functional team and work closely with the other developers, designers, producers, all working together on a game enjoyed by over 100,000,000 players worldwide. We have big dreams for the future of Minecraft Realms and need your help to make them a reality.\u00a0 \u00a0 

Experiences where users play together are essential, and a big aspect of the role is to implement this vision in a robust and performant way. This in turn means that communication with other developers, services, design, and UX is a key day-to-day cornerstone. By joining the Realms and Gatherings team, you will find an environment that enables you to leverage your knowledge and values to maintain and evolve a healthy and collaborative culture as we grow.\u00a0 \u00a0 

Microsoft\u2019s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. \u00a0 

In the end, it\u2019s the people of Mojang Studios that make this place truly special. When you join, you\u2019ll find yourself in the company of incredibly bright, warm, and creative individuals \u2013 all united and working toward a single goal. Come help us reach it!

ResponsibilitiesWork with the Development and Design Team to implement new features in Minecraft Online.\u00a0Collaborating with C++ developers on building new UI and making API decisions.\u00a0Work with designers and producers to solve user needs.\u00a0Support our existing features and help evolve them.\u00a0Improve ways of working and technical best practices within the team.\u00a0Embody our Culture & Values.QualificationsRequired Qualifications:

\u00a0

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript\u00a0OR equivalent experience.\u00a0

Preferred Qualifications:

\u00a0

Experience in React and UX (User Experience)\u00a0development.1+ year of experience building large-scale applications.\u00a0Communication and problem-solving skills, as well as being a natural collaborator and team player.\u00a0Experience working in product teams that build user-facing features.\u00a0#mojangjobs #gamingjobs\u00a0

 Software Engineering IC4 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $119,800 - $234,700 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $158,400 - $258,000 per year. 

 Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay
